name: Barrow Key
summary: Deep beneath Stonetalon Peak, three druidic keys guard the Talon Den's ancient hoard. The Barrow Key lies locked within the den.

sections.title: A Guardian's Safeguard
sections.body:
Night elf druids warded the underground barrows of the Talon Den to keep intruders from their relics. Among the passages, the Barrow Key rests in a hidden cache. Reaching it means passing through the druids' layered defenses.

Only the Gatekeeper's Key opens the cache. A seeker must know how those defenses work to claim the Barrow Key.

sections.title: Unlocking the Hoard
sections.body: The Barrow Key, the Claw Key, and the Sleepers' Key fit three carved keyholes in a stone altar deep in the Talon Den. Turn all three together, and the protective enchantments fade. Then the druidic relics in the hidden hoard lie within reach.

faq.q: What is the Barrow Key used for?
faq.answer: The Barrow Key works with the Claw Key and the Sleepers' Key to open the Talon Den Hoard. The stone chest holds protected druidic relics deep within Stonetalon Peak.

faq.q: Where is the Barrow Key hidden?
faq.answer: The Barrow Key is locked inside a barrow cache deep in the Talon Den's winding tunnels on Stonetalon Peak. The cache resembles a concealed wall torch.

faq.q: How do you open the cache containing the Barrow Key?
faq.answer: You need the Gatekeeper's Key to open the cache. The druids hid it in a small lantern near the Talon Den's main entrance.

faq.q: Who hidden the Barrow Key in the Talon Den?
aliases: who hid the keys in talon den
faq.answer: Night elf druids living in Stonetalon Peak devised the Talon Den's defenses to keep their powerful artifacts from hostile hands. They concealed the keys in different parts of the den.

angles.text: As a druid, you know the Barrow Key belongs to an ancient security rite. The druids of the Talon Den designed it to protect sacred belongings in their underground sanctuary.
Horde operatives in Stonetalon Mountains pry information from captured night elves to find the Barrow Key and plunder the druids' private hoard.
